description: The Lectric XP Lite 2.0 is a newly upgraded version of our lightest and most affordable eBike to date, the XP Lite. Weighing in at just 49 pounds, the foldable XP Lite is ready to tackle everything from trips into town to exciting joyrides with a Lectrifying twist of the throttle. A Gates Carbon Drive Belt system provides nearly maintenance-free functionality! On top of that, enjoy hydraulic brakes, Lectric PWR programming, an LCD color display, and much more. The XP Lite 2.0 also includes an option to add a long-range battery.

components.description: Hydraulic mineral oil brakes and 180mm rotors (1.8mm thick) offer ultimate stopping power and peace of mind in wet or dry conditions.
cog makes for a single speed drivetrain
Gates SideTrack aluminum 70-tooth chainring is the perfect ratio for effortless 20-inch wheel pedaling.

Gates SideTrack 125-tooth Carbon Drive Belt System is lightweight and carbon fiber-reinforced. The belt’s performance is nearly maintenance-free while providing a chainless drivetrain that’s clean, quiet, smooth, and strong.

Available with a Standard or Long-Range 48V lithium-ion battery (375Wh or 672Wh) certified to UL 2271 to power your ride for up to 80 miles, respectively.*† The Lectric XP Lite is also certified to UL 2849.
An external charging port provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. The XP Lite comes standard with a 2amp charger for 2-4 hour charging.

A 300W rear hub-motor (819W Peak) with 28Nm of torque delivers power and speed quicker than ever before. Stealth M24 technology is 400% quieter‡, delivering a hushed motor experience without sacrificing power.
A backlit, color LCD display with a USB-A port provides trip and battery intelligence on the go. IP-65 rated electrical components ensure greater water and dust resistance.
15 amp controller is IP-65 rated with built in thermal sensors to eliminate burn-out.
Rigid Steel Fork with a threadless headset.
Soft durometer ergonomic grips add comfort so you can ride longer. Removable caps on the end allow for various accessory add-on.
Newly added BMX-style handlebars are sturdy, comfortable, and offer more opportunities for customizing your ride with accessories.
A heavy-duty side-sweeping kickstand located near the chain stay keeps the eBike upright.
An integrated safety system, featuring a headlamp and taillight powered by the battery allows you to be seen at any time of day.
Push-fold pedals are easily compressed for compact transport.
A custom-designed saddle compliments a sportier look and can be angle adjusted.
A half-twist throttle is easily engaged with a flick of the wrist to deliver pure power on demand.
20x2.5'' slick tires featuring a reflective strip are equipped with 3mm Hippo Skin with an Aramid Floc Breaker. Slime is installed to prevent flat tires at no additional cost.

Lectric's Pedal Assist Wattage Regulation (PWR) programming allows for an improved Pedal Assist experience by assisting the rider up to a certain power level for each PAS setting, instead of limiting the assistance by speed alone. Learn more about PWR here. Prefer full wattage while you ride? Access the advanced settings of your display to toggle off PWR Programming.
